question.text:
The exothermic formation of $\mathrm{ClF}_3$ is represented by the equation:
$$
\mathrm{Cl}_{2(g)}+3 \mathrm{~F}_{2(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2 \mathrm{ClF}_{3(g)} ; \Delta \mathrm{r} \mathrm{H}=-329 \mathrm{~kJ}
$$
Which of the following will increase the quantity of $\mathrm{ClF}_3$ in an equilibrium mixture of $\mathrm{Cl}_2, \mathrm{~F}_2$ and $\mathrm{ClF}_3$ ?

options.text: Increasing the volume of the container
